backend/main.mo: Minimal Motoko canister with no backend logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two frontend feature updates with related files and metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of various frontend files including content, components, config, and deployment docs.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Mainnet deployment guide covering prerequisites, automated/manual steps, troubleshooting, and best practices.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH color tokens, dark mode values, and global element styles.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML shell loading the React app entrypoint.
frontend/scripts/deploy-ic.ts: Automated script running preflight checks, building the frontend, and deploying to IC mainnet.
frontend/scripts/preflight-production.ts: Runs TypeScript and asset checks before production deployment, exiting on failure.
frontend/scripts/verify-assets.ts: Checks required static assets exist in the public assets directory and fails if any are missing.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React layout composing header, sections, footer, wrapped in an error boundary.
frontend/src/components/ContactForm.tsx: Interactive contact form with validation, simulated submission, and success/error messaging.
frontend/src/components/ProductionErrorB: Error boundary showing a user-friendly fallback UI with reload option on runtime errors.
frontend/src/components/sections/AboutSe: Displays the About section with marketing text and value cards using icons.
frontend/src/components/sections/Contact: Provides contact details and a contact form, including sanitized phone links.
frontend/src/components/sections/HeroSec: Displays the hero banner with background image, headline text, and CTA buttons.
frontend/src/components/sections/Service: Shows a grid of service cards using marketing content and mapped icons.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Renders the footer with brand info, quick links, social icons, and URL validation for external links.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Renders a responsive header with scroll detection, navigation links, mobile menu, and brand assets.
frontend/src/content/brandAssets.ts: Centralizes paths for logo and hero images for consistent brand asset usage.
frontend/src/content/marketingCopy.ts: Exports marketing text for hero, about, services, and contact sections.
frontend/src/content/socialLinks.ts: Defines configurable social media profile URLs.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor, refreshing queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication using AuthClient, including login, logout, and status tracking.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file prepared for future backend query hooks, currently exporting nothing.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom OKLCH color variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/lib/scrollToSection.ts: Implements smooth scrolling to a page section with dynamic offset based on header height.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and loads global styles.
frontend/src/vite-env.d.ts: Provides Vite type definitions for TypeScript.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, animations, plugins, and container settings.
frontend/tsconfig.node.json: TypeScript config for Vite node-related files with module and resolution settings.
frontend/vite.config.ts: Vite configuration for React app with path aliasing, build output, and dev server settings.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, feature requirements, issues, and state for a social-link fix task.
